attack: A correctly signed and otherwise matching permit is presented only after its signed expiry boundary has passed.
bounded_finding: Under frozen deterministic P2-H08, a correctly signed permit whose expiry boundary had already passed did not authorize execution.
nonclaim: This establishes only the frozen deterministic permit-expiry behavior of the tested permit/firewall/broker path. It does not establish distributed clock synchronization, trusted-time infrastructure, or production behavior.
